title: Harold Malmgren's CIA connections and IDA cover
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Harold Malmgren's CIA connections and IDA cover, about 1960s; 2024 interview at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Okay, here are a few a few fun facts. If you watch that interview I did with him, he says I was best friends with Tom Farmer. Happened to be the GC, the general counsel of the CIA.
He had Paul Melon's walking stick in the interview, and I'm holding it for half the time in the interview
tellings.difference: Adds that Michels held Paul Mellon's walking stick during the interview, and mentions Dean Johnson and Malmgren's diary.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Michels telling of Malmgren's hidden CIA connections (Tom Farmer, Paul Mellon) as they came out in his interview.

as_told.title: Malmgren's hidden CIA ties and Paul Mellon's walking stick

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Harold Malmgren, a man he interviewed in 2024, told him he had been best friends with Tom Farmer, the top lawyer of the CIA, the US spy agency, and Michels suggests that Malmgren's work with IDA, the Institute for Defense Analyses, a defense research group, served as cover for CIA ties going back to the 1960s. Michels adds that during the interview he held a walking stick that once belonged to the wealthy Paul Mellon, and he cites Malmgren's diary, which, if his reading is right, would mean Malmgren was close to the inner circle of US intelligence.
